    Web Scraper / Data Extraction Developer (Python)

    • Fixed price
    • Expert
    • Est. budget: $100.00

    Web Scraper / Data Extraction Developer (Python) We are seeking an experienced Web Scraper / Data Extraction Developer to build a reliable, maintainable scraper that collects structured data from four public websites. The data will be used strictly for internal research and analysis. All sources are publicly accessible, and scraping must comply with ethical and legal best practices. Responsibilities Build a robust scraper to extract structured data from four public websites Clean, normalize, and validate scraped data Deliver data in CSV, JSON, or database-ready formats Handle pagination, rate limiting, and basic bot protections Ensure the scraper is re-runnable, well-structured, and maintainable Provide clear documentation explaining the scraping logic and usage Required Skills Strong experience with Python-based web scraping Proven experience using tools such as: BeautifulSoup Requests Scrapy Selenium Playwright Experience scraping: Dynamic, JavaScript-rendered websites Sites with basic anti-bot protections (CAPTCHA awareness, request delays, headers, etc.) Strong skills in data cleaning and structuring Ability to write clear, well-documented, production-ready code Nice to Have Experience scraping government or public record websites Experience with: Rotating proxies and user agents Docker or containerized execution Scheduling or automation (cron jobs, Airflow, AWS Lambda, etc.) Familiarity with compliance and legal considerations around public data collection

    CAD Automation Specialist for Pipe Spool Generation

    • Hourly: $25.00 - $40.00
    • Intermediate
    • Est. time: 1 to 3 months, Less than 30 hrs/week

    Job Overview We are hiring an experienced AutoCAD automation developer to work on DWG file parsing and data extraction. This is NOT a web, mobile, or SaaS project. Only developers with real AutoCAD / DWG automation experience should apply. Scope of Work (Phase 1 – Test & Validation) Open and analyze DWG files Extract: Layer inventory Entity type counts Text and block inventories Export structured outputs (CSV or JSON) Deliver fully executable and editable source code Note: Precise spool ID recognition is out of scope for Phase 1. Technical Requirements (Mandatory) Hands-on AutoCAD experience Practical DWG structure understanding One or more of the following: AutoLISP AutoCAD API scripting CAD automation scripting Ability to explain technical limitations clearly Clean, commented, readable code Contract Type & Controls (Read Carefully) Hourly contract Weekly limit: 10 hours Manual time is NOT allowed Screenshots ON Video demos are NOT accepted as deliverables Executable source code is mandatory Time without code submission will not be approved Research / learning / trial-only time is not billable AI-generated code must be declared Violation of any rule = immediate contract termination. NDA NDA required. Any NDA violation results in immediate termination. Phase 1 – Milestone Specification (Very Important) M1 Goal From provided DWG files: Extract layer list Count entities by type Extract basic text and block inventories Export results to CSV or JSON M1 Breakdown (Micro-Milestones) M1-0. Execution Setup Single command/script execution Successful DWG open without error Execution log included M1-1. Layer Inventory Output: layers.csv/json Fields include at least: layer_name (mandatory) visibility/frozen status M1-2. Entity Type Count Output: entity_counts.csv/json Minimum 6 entity types counted TEXT / MTEXT / INSERT must appear if present in DWG M1-3. Text & Block Inventory Text output fields: type, value, layer, x, y Block output fields: block_name, layer, x, y Coordinates must be numeric M1-4. Packaging & Reproducibility ZIP package: /src source code /output sample results README.md README must allow a third party to run without guidance Approval Rules Each sub-step reviewed immediately No code = no approval Screenshots or videos alone are rejected Weekly hour cap strictly enforced How to Apply (Required) Answer all questions below. Generic proposals will be ignored.
